title: AuthPage
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column with androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll, androidx.compose.foundation.layout.imePadding and widthIn, holding MonarchCard, MonarchText, MonarchTextField, MonarchPasswordInput, MonarchButton and MonarchLink
summary: A recipe, not a component: the centered, scrollable, keyboard-safe layout for sign-in, sign-up, password reset and verification screens, with a heading, an optional notice, the app's form, a footer line and small legal links.
whenToUse: For the screens before the person is signed in: sign in, create an account, reset a password, verify an email address.
whenNotToUse: For settings or profile forms inside the app, use the app's normal screen layout. For a sign-in step inside another flow, a MonarchResponsiveDialog may be enough.
api: fun Modifier.verticalScroll(state: ScrollState, enabled: Boolean = true, flingBehavior: FlingBehavior? = null, reverseScrolling: Boolean = false): Modifier
fun Modifier.widthIn(min: Dp = Dp.Unspecified, max: Dp = Dp.Unspecified): Modifier
@Composable fun MonarchCard(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, elevated: Boolean = false, contentPadding: PaddingValues = …, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

states.name: default
states.description: The heading, the description, the fields and the main button in a card, centered, with the footer and legal links under it.

states.name: notice
states.description: A MonarchInlineNotice above the fields, for an expired session or a failed attempt.

states.name: keyboard open
states.description: imePadding keeps the focused field and the button above the keyboard; the column scrolls.

states.name: large window
states.description: widthIn keeps the card at a readable width, centered.

appearance: The canvas background with the form in a MonarchCard on the surface color with the default border, the heading in the title style, the description in the muted text color and the legal links in the subtle link style. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web AuthPage is a layout component with brand, notice, footer, links and a side panel above 1024 pixels. On Android it is a recipe: verticalScroll with imePadding keeps the form clear of the keyboard, widthIn keeps it readable on a tablet, and the side panel is left out (on a large window, show it in a supporting pane if needed). The heading level becomes the heading semantics of MonarchText. Fields take autofill hints through the app's own semantics (contentType) so password managers fill them. iOS uses the same recipe.
accessibility: The title is a heading, so TalkBack users can jump to it.
Each field has a visible label that TalkBack reads; MonarchPasswordInput has a labelled show and hide button.
The main button and the links have 48dp touch targets.
The column scrolls at large font sizes and with the keyboard open, so no field is cut off.
edgeCases: On a short landscape phone the card may be taller than the screen: the column must scroll.
Keep the brand image decorative (contentDescription = null) when the heading already names the product.
